people.name: Abda
people.line: Father of Adoram, who was over forced labor

people.name: Adoram

translations.web: Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor.
translations.bsb: Ahishar was in charge of the palace; and Adoniram son of Abda was in charge of the forced labor.
translations.kjv: And Ahishar was over the household: and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the tribute.
translations.asv: and Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to taskwork.
